svg.aria-label: Region 5, The Lighthouse Stair: a stack. push() slides a stone out of the lighthouse wall on top of the stack and the traveler climbs onto it, because only the top stone holds. The fog bell rings at the top, then pop() takes the stones back in, the last one set first, and the traveler comes down to the sea door.
